title: 100 Hours SMP
description: Can you survive 100 Hours? even when everything is trying to kill you?
body:
## Do you have what it takes to reach 100 hours?

With this datapack, time is your lifeline. Each death costs you one hour.

Too forgiving? Not anymore—health regeneration is completely disabled.

Survive. Endure. Reach 100 hours.

Ideal for players looking for a tough survival challenge.'

> To enable, copy the file you downloaded, then paste it into the following folder directory in the world you want to install them in: <World name>/datapacks. once you are in the world, run the commmand /function hardcore:reset

Note: Better with friends
